prompts.primary_user: Busy parent ordering weekly groceries on mobile
prompts.constraint: One-handed mobile use, frequent interruptions
prompts.problem: Design a reorder experience that rebuilds a weekly cart quickly without re-buying items the household no longer needs.
prompts.watch_for: Silent substitutions that erode trust in the cart
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how you balanced speed against accidental purchases.

prompts.primary_user: Frequent business traveler booking on mobile
prompts.business_goal: Increase direct bookings over third-party sites
prompts.constraint: Mobile-first, one-handed, four comparison factors at once
prompts.problem: Design a hotel booking flow for someone comparing price, commute time to their meeting, cancellation flexibility, and loyalty perks - without opening six tabs.
prompts.watch_for: Comparison overload that pushes users back to a spreadsheet
prompts.interview_focus: Walk through how you decided what belongs on the card versus the detail view.

prompts.primary_user: First-time seller listing a used item from their phone
prompts.constraint: Users abandon if listing takes more than about 3 minutes
prompts.problem: Design a listing flow that gets a first-time seller from photos to a published, well-priced listing in one sitting.
prompts.watch_for: Price anxiety - sellers stall when asked to pick a number
prompts.interview_focus: Explain which steps you cut, deferred, or defaulted - and why.

prompts.primary_user: Clinic intake coordinator
prompts.constraint: Staff must approve every AI recommendation before it affects scheduling
prompts.problem: Design an AI-assisted intake review flow that helps staff identify missing or risky patient information before appointment scheduling.
prompts.ai_capability: Summarizes patient-submitted forms and flags missing or risky details
prompts.watch_for: Staff over-trusting incorrect AI flags
prompts.interview_focus: Show exactly what the coordinator sees when the AI is wrong.

prompts.primary_user: Paralegal reviewing contract drafts at a mid-size firm
prompts.business_goal: Reduce time spent identifying risky clauses
prompts.constraint: AI cannot make final legal recommendations - it can only assist review
prompts.problem: Design an AI-assisted contract review experience that helps a paralegal identify risky clauses, compare them against firm standards, and prepare notes for an attorney.
prompts.ai_capability: Highlights risky clauses, explains them in plain English, suggests alternative language
prompts.watch_for: Confident-sounding suggestions that miss legal nuance
prompts.interview_focus: Defend where the human approval gate sits and what it costs.

prompts.primary_user: Fraud analyst reviewing flagged transactions
prompts.business_goal: Reduce false positives without slowing real fraud response
prompts.constraint: Every AI recommendation must be explainable to auditors
prompts.problem: Design an AI-assisted fraud review workflow where the analyst can triage flagged transactions, see why each was flagged, and act in seconds.
prompts.ai_capability: Risk-scores transactions and generates a rationale from account signals
prompts.watch_for: Legitimate customers punished by a confident wrong score
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how the interface earns calibrated trust - not blind trust.

prompts.primary_user: Warehouse operations manager between floor checks
prompts.constraint: The user has only 5 minutes between floor checks
prompts.problem: Design a dashboard that helps the manager identify which delayed shipments need action now versus which can wait.
prompts.watch_for: A wall of equally-urgent red that helps no one
prompts.interview_focus: Justify your information hierarchy for a 5-minute glance.

prompts.primary_user: Product manager preparing for Monday metrics review
prompts.business_goal: Catch real regressions before customers do
prompts.constraint: Checked between meetings, on a laptop, in under 10 minutes
prompts.problem: Design a weekly product-health dashboard that separates noise from what needs a decision this week.
prompts.watch_for: Vanity metrics crowding out actionable ones
prompts.interview_focus: Explain what you left off the dashboard and why.

prompts.primary_user: Homeowner trying to lower a surprising electric bill
prompts.constraint: Users are not energy experts - kWh means nothing to them
prompts.problem: Design a home energy view that turns raw usage data into one or two behavior changes worth making this week.
prompts.watch_for: Charts that inform but never change behavior
prompts.interview_focus: Show how you translated data into a decision, not a chart.

prompts.primary_user: Older adult paying bills online
prompts.business_goal: Reduce payment errors and support calls
prompts.constraint: User may have low vision, money anxiety, or limited digital confidence
prompts.problem: Design a bill payment confirmation flow that clearly communicates amount, due date, account, confirmation, and how to fix mistakes.
prompts.watch_for: Anxiety-inducing ambiguity about whether money actually moved
prompts.interview_focus: Walk through the flow as someone with low vision and low confidence.

prompts.primary_user: Blind commuter planning a trip with a screen reader
prompts.constraint: Must work fully non-visually; service alerts change mid-trip
prompts.problem: Design a trip-planning and live-guidance flow that a screen reader user can operate confidently, including when a delay forces a replan.
prompts.watch_for: Visual-only status cues (color dots, map pins) carrying critical meaning
prompts.interview_focus: Describe the screen-reader experience out loud, stop by stop.

prompts.primary_user: Benefits applicant with limited digital confidence
prompts.constraint: Legal content must be preserved; reading level must not gate completion
prompts.problem: Design a multi-step benefits application that prevents errors up front and makes recovery obvious when documents are missing.
prompts.watch_for: Dead ends where the user can't tell what's wrong or what to do next
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how the design fails gracefully - that's the real test.

prompts.primary_user: Workspace admin managing roles for 500 employees
prompts.constraint: Over-permissioning is a security risk; under-permissioning blocks work
prompts.problem: Design a roles-and-permissions experience where an admin can confidently answer: who can do what, and why?
prompts.watch_for: A checkbox grid nobody can reason about
prompts.interview_focus: Show how the admin verifies a change did what they intended.

prompts.primary_user: Finance approver reviewing purchase requests
prompts.business_goal: Cut approval cycle time without weakening controls
prompts.constraint: Compliance requires a traceable decision record for every request
prompts.problem: Design an approval workflow where routine requests move fast and unusual ones get real scrutiny.
prompts.watch_for: Rubber-stamping - the interface making approve the path of least attention
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how the design directs attention to the 5% that matters.

prompts.primary_user: Operations lead importing 40,000 customer records
prompts.business_goal: Reduce failed migrations and support escalations
prompts.constraint: Errors surface at scale - hundreds at a time, not one by one
prompts.problem: Design an import experience that turns 800 validation errors into a manageable, fixable job instead of a wall of failure.
prompts.watch_for: Error lists that scale visually but not cognitively
prompts.interview_focus: Walk through the moment the user sees 800 errors - then what?

prompts.primary_user: Team lead writing weekly project updates
prompts.constraint: Must be componentized and reusable across teams
prompts.problem: Design a structured status composer with sections for progress, blockers, decisions, and next steps - as a real component, not just a screen.
prompts.watch_for: States you forgot to design: autosave conflicts, half-filled sections, stale drafts
prompts.interview_focus: Present the state model like you'd hand it to an engineer - because you are one.

prompts.primary_user: Developer theming a portal without design support
prompts.business_goal: Ship on-brand portals without design bottlenecks
prompts.constraint: Every generated theme must pass WCAG AA contrast automatically
prompts.problem: Design a theme builder that lets a non-designer pick brand colors and typography while the system quietly guarantees accessible, coherent results.
prompts.watch_for: Freedom that lets users build something broken
prompts.interview_focus: Explain where you constrained the user on purpose.

prompts.primary_user: Power user managing notifications across channels
prompts.business_goal: Reduce notification-driven churn and mute-everything behavior
prompts.constraint: Preference matrix spans 4 channels x 12 event types; must stay componentized
prompts.problem: Design a notification preferences center that helps users tune signal from noise without reading a settings matrix like a tax form.
prompts.watch_for: The all-or-nothing trap: users flip the master switch and disappear
prompts.interview_focus: Show how the component scales when event types double.

prompts.primary_user: Returning learner browsing an unfamiliar course library
prompts.business_goal: Increase successful content discovery and course completion
prompts.constraint: The library contains 500 resources described with inconsistent internal terminology
prompts.problem: Design the information architecture for a learning library so people can browse by goal, search in their own words, and confidently choose what to learn next.
prompts.watch_for: A taxonomy that mirrors the company org chart instead of the learner's mental model
prompts.interview_focus: Defend your grouping and labels using a card-sort or tree-test plan.

prompts.primary_user: Patient reviewing next steps after a clinical visit
prompts.business_goal: Reduce missed follow-up tasks and avoidable support calls
prompts.constraint: Messages, results, appointments, bills, and care tasks come from different systems
prompts.problem: Reorganize a patient portal so people can distinguish information to read from actions to complete, without needing to understand the hospital's departments.
prompts.watch_for: One inbox that mixes urgent care tasks with receipts and informational updates
prompts.interview_focus: Show how a new result becomes findable today and six months later.

prompts.primary_user: New employee searching for the current company policy
prompts.business_goal: Reduce time lost searching and prevent use of outdated guidance
prompts.constraint: Content has owners, permissions, regional variants, duplicates, and expiration dates
prompts.problem: Design the information architecture for an enterprise knowledge hub that helps employees find the authoritative answer and understand why it applies to them.
prompts.watch_for: Search results that rank popular but obsolete documents above the current source of truth
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how your structure survives regional variants, renamed policies, and stale content.

prompts.primary_user: Caregiver arranging recurring meal deliveries
prompts.constraint: Delivery needs and recipients change week to week
prompts.problem: Design a recurring meal-delivery flow that lets a caregiver adjust recipients, dietary needs, dates, and quantities without rebuilding every order.
prompts.watch_for: A convenient default sending the wrong meal to the wrong person
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how the design makes repetition fast without hiding consequential changes.

prompts.primary_user: Friend organizing seats for a group outing
prompts.constraint: Seats may disappear while people decide and pay
prompts.problem: Design a group ticket-buying flow where one organizer can propose seats, collect decisions, and complete the purchase before availability changes.
prompts.watch_for: Unclear ownership when a hold expires or one person drops out
prompts.interview_focus: Show what happens when one person has not responded and the hold is about to expire.

prompts.primary_user: Renter granting temporary building access
prompts.business_goal: Increase trusted use of digital access
prompts.constraint: Guests may arrive when the renter is unavailable
prompts.problem: Design a temporary access flow for guests, cleaners, or delivery workers that is fast to create and easy to revoke.
prompts.watch_for: Access remaining active longer or reaching more doors than intended
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how the design keeps temporary access understandable after several passes exist.

prompts.primary_user: Support agent resolving a disputed refund
prompts.business_goal: Shorten resolution time without incorrect refunds
prompts.constraint: Policy exceptions require supervisor approval
prompts.problem: Design an AI-assisted support workspace that summarizes the case, finds relevant policy, and drafts a response while keeping the agent accountable.
prompts.ai_capability: Summarizes the conversation, retrieves policy, and proposes a resolution
prompts.watch_for: A polished draft concealing an outdated or inapplicable policy
prompts.interview_focus: Show how the agent notices, corrects, and records a wrong policy recommendation.

prompts.primary_user: Teacher adapting a lesson for mixed reading levels
prompts.constraint: The teacher remains responsible for accuracy and curriculum fit
prompts.problem: Design an AI-assisted lesson adaptation flow that creates reading-level variants while helping the teacher verify facts, tone, and learning objectives.
prompts.ai_capability: Rewrites lesson material and explains major changes
prompts.watch_for: Simplification removing essential meaning or introducing factual errors
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how the teacher can verify quality without rereading every sentence.

prompts.primary_user: Recruiter reviewing a large applicant pool
prompts.business_goal: Reduce screening effort while preserving fairness
prompts.constraint: Sensitive attributes must not influence recommendations
prompts.problem: Design an AI-assisted applicant review flow that groups candidates by job evidence and makes ranking assumptions visible and challengeable.
prompts.ai_capability: Extracts role evidence and suggests a review order
prompts.watch_for: Proxy signals recreating bias behind an apparently neutral score
prompts.interview_focus: Show how a recruiter investigates and overturns a questionable ranking.

prompts.primary_user: Fundraising director planning next week's outreach
prompts.constraint: The team can personally contact only 20 donors per week
prompts.problem: Design a donor-health dashboard that helps a fundraising director decide who needs attention and what action to take next.
prompts.watch_for: High-value donors dominating the view while retention risk stays hidden
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how the dashboard turns limited outreach capacity into a defensible priority list.

prompts.primary_user: Independent creator reviewing a content launch
prompts.constraint: Performance varies widely by channel and audience size
prompts.problem: Design a post-launch dashboard that tells a creator what worked, what underperformed, and what to try in the next release.
prompts.watch_for: Engagement totals encouraging shallow comparisons across unequal audiences
prompts.interview_focus: Show how you prevent vanity metrics from becoming the product's advice.

prompts.primary_user: Water operations supervisor monitoring district leaks
prompts.business_goal: Reduce water loss and emergency repairs
prompts.constraint: Sensor quality varies and field crews are limited
prompts.problem: Design an operations dashboard that separates likely leaks from bad sensor readings and helps assign the right field response.
prompts.watch_for: False precision causing crews to chase unreliable alerts
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how the supervisor chooses action when severity is high but confidence is low.

prompts.primary_user: Deaf attendee following a live conference session
prompts.constraint: Captions may lag, lose speakers, or fail mid-session
prompts.problem: Design a live-session experience that combines captions, speaker identity, slides, and recovery when transcription quality drops.
prompts.watch_for: Critical meaning disappearing when captions lag behind slide changes
prompts.interview_focus: Walk through what the attendee experiences when captions fail during an important announcement.

prompts.primary_user: Patient with limited hand mobility joining a visit
prompts.constraint: The flow must work with keyboard, switch control, or voice
prompts.problem: Design a telehealth check-in and call experience that minimizes precise gestures and supports recovery from audio or camera problems.
prompts.watch_for: Small transient controls making essential actions physically unreachable
prompts.interview_focus: Describe the complete flow without relying on touch or pointer precision.

prompts.primary_user: Claimant with cognitive fatigue after an accident
prompts.business_goal: Reduce incomplete claims and repeat support calls
prompts.constraint: The process requires detailed evidence across several sessions
prompts.problem: Design a claim-submission flow that reduces memory burden, explains progress clearly, and makes returning after a break effortless.
prompts.watch_for: A technically complete checklist that overwhelms users into stopping
prompts.interview_focus: Show how the user understands what is done, what is next, and what can wait.

prompts.primary_user: Incident commander coordinating a production outage
prompts.constraint: Information changes rapidly across many tools and teams
prompts.problem: Design an incident command workspace that keeps ownership, decisions, system status, and stakeholder updates aligned during an outage.
prompts.watch_for: A busy activity stream obscuring the current plan and accountable owner
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how a new responder gets oriented in under two minutes.

prompts.primary_user: Vendor manager onboarding a new supplier
prompts.constraint: Legal, security, finance, and operations approve different evidence
prompts.problem: Design a vendor-onboarding workflow that shows what is blocked, who owns the next step, and which evidence can be reused.
prompts.watch_for: A single progress percentage hiding a critical compliance blocker
prompts.interview_focus: Show how the vendor manager distinguishes waiting from genuinely blocked.

prompts.primary_user: Operations planner building a weekly shift schedule
prompts.business_goal: Fill shifts fairly with fewer manual corrections
prompts.constraint: Skills, availability, overtime, and labor rules interact
prompts.problem: Design a shift-planning experience that helps an operations planner resolve coverage gaps without creating hidden fairness or compliance problems.
prompts.watch_for: A schedule that looks complete while repeatedly disadvantaging the same workers
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how the planner evaluates the consequences of an apparently easy fix.

prompts.primary_user: Operations analyst editing hundreds of records
prompts.constraint: Bulk changes must remain reversible and auditable
prompts.problem: Design a reusable data-table component for filtering, selecting, editing, and safely applying changes across hundreds of records.
prompts.watch_for: Selection state becoming ambiguous after filters or pages change
prompts.interview_focus: Explain exactly what remains selected when the user changes a filter.

prompts.primary_user: Product team migrating to a new component library
prompts.constraint: Old and new components must coexist during migration
prompts.problem: Design a component migration assistant that helps teams find deprecated usage, understand replacements, and track rollout safely.
prompts.watch_for: A migration checklist ignoring visual or behavioral differences
prompts.interview_focus: Show how a team decides whether a replacement is truly equivalent.

prompts.primary_user: Technician completing inspections without connectivity
prompts.business_goal: Reduce lost work and delayed reports
prompts.constraint: Devices may be offline for an entire shift
prompts.problem: Design an offline-first inspection form component that saves evidence locally, communicates sync state, and resolves conflicting edits.
prompts.watch_for: A reassuring saved message referring only to unsynced local data
prompts.interview_focus: Explain every state between tapping save offline and confirmed server sync.

prompts.primary_user: Resident seeking help without knowing the agency name
prompts.constraint: Hundreds of services are owned by separate departments
prompts.problem: Design the information architecture for a city services site organized around resident needs rather than government departments.
prompts.watch_for: Everyday tasks hidden behind official language and agency boundaries
prompts.interview_focus: Defend how someone finds the right service without knowing who provides it.

prompts.primary_user: Household member finding something appropriate to watch
prompts.constraint: One account contains different ages, tastes, and viewing contexts
prompts.problem: Design the information architecture for a streaming home experience that supports personal taste, shared viewing, age suitability, and unfinished content.
prompts.watch_for: Recommendation rows becoming an endless taxonomy with no clear wayfinding
prompts.interview_focus: Explain how the structure changes when the intent is family viewing rather than personal viewing.

prompts.primary_user: Developer troubleshooting an unfamiliar API integration
prompts.business_goal: Reduce time to first successful integration
prompts.constraint: Documentation spans concepts, guides, references, examples, and versions
prompts.problem: Design the information architecture for developer documentation so users can learn a concept, complete a task, and recover from an error without losing context.
prompts.watch_for: Search mixing obsolete versions and concept pages with current task guidance
prompts.interview_focus: Show how a developer moves between a guide, reference, and error explanation while staying on the right version.
